features.name: oc_mean_word_length
features.definition: What is the average number of characters per word across all words in the counter-argument comments?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings. If malformed/missing return null; if empty list return null. Concatenate all comments' text, extract words with re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9']+", text) (case preserved, apostrophes kept), and return total characters in these tokens divided by number of tokens (pooled across all comments). Return null if there are zero tokens. Raw text; includes any quoted text or outcome announcements present in comments.

h0: oc_mean_word_length has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Higher oc_mean_word_length is associated with a higher probability of delta.
note: Reading complexity is operationalized only as average word length (characters per word), as the hypothesis states "longer average words"; no readability index is used. Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP view change). Pooled over all words in all available comments; comment order and timing are unknown. Comments may contain quotations of others or outcome-related text (e.g., delta mentions), not removed since this is a raw code measure. Association only, not causal.
